research_goal: Research the safest maintainable architecture for a Vercel-deployable Next.js repository monitoring site.
coding_context: New root project workspace-monitor with Next.js App Router, repository document snapshot generation, and static dashboard UI.
source_value_provenance: Next.js static export output mode <- Next.js Static Exports official docs checked 2026-06-01.
Vercel Next.js deployment support <- Vercel Next.js official docs checked 2026-06-01.
Markdown/MDX handling alternatives <- Next.js MDX guide checked 2026-06-01.
Icon package install and license review <- lucide-react npm page checked 2026-06-01.
Project boundary and install audit rules <- local _ops and _docs policies checked 2026-06-01.
plan_evidence: Use Next.js static export <- user requested Vercel and public deploy readiness, official docs support output export.
Use generated snapshot <- repository is private now and public later, so data exposure should be reviewable before deploy.
Use a separate root project <- project-boundary workflow says substantial independent work belongs in its own root folder.
Avoid full MDX execution for repository docs <- escaped preview meets readability goal while reducing raw HTML execution risk.
stack_version_constraints: Use Node >=20.9.0 in package engines for modern Next.js support.
Next.js docs checked on 2026-06-01 show latest version 16.2.2.
package-lock.json records exact installed dependency tree after npm install.
issue_discussion_notes: High-signal project discussions and Q&A are useful for future debugging, but this implementation uses official docs and small local tests as primary proof.
No blocking current issue was found before implementation; community sources are treated as risk discovery signals.
community_signal_notes: GitHub discussions, Stack Overflow votes, and package registry popularity are adoption/discovery signals, not standalone factual proof.
language_options: TypeScript with Next.js for Vercel-ready UI, typed snapshot imports, and React component structure.
Python static HTML generator using existing workspace Python tools.
Plain HTML/CSS/JS static artifact without framework.
selected_language: TypeScript with Next.js for Vercel-ready UI, typed snapshot imports, and React component structure.
language_decision_notes: Selected TypeScript/Next.js because the user explicitly requested Next.js and Vercel deployment.
Rejected Python-only static HTML because it would be less aligned with Vercel's Next.js workflow.
Rejected plain HTML because the dashboard is expected to grow into richer management UI.
code_reference_notes: Reuse the repository's existing pattern of generated operation maps and coordination boards, but keep monitor-specific code inside workspace-monitor.
Use App Router files app/layout.tsx and app/page.tsx with project-local components and generated data.
architecture_options: Static snapshot dashboard: collect repository docs into JSON and render with static Next.js pages.
Server-side repository reader: deploy a server function that reads repository files at request time.
Single generated HTML artifact: generate one static HTML dashboard without Next.js.
architecture_decision_notes: Selected static snapshot dashboard because it is Vercel-friendly, public-reviewable, and avoids runtime file access ambiguity.
Rejected server-side repository reader because Vercel runtime file access and private data exposure are harder to reason about.
Rejected single HTML artifact because the user requested Next.js and future extensibility.
architecture_tradeoff_notes: Theory favors clear data producer/consumer boundaries; practitioner deployment guidance favors static assets for simple public dashboards. Both support the snapshot-first architecture.
folder_structure_options: Next.js feature folders inside workspace-monitor with app, components, lib, scripts, src/generated, docs, specs, tests.
Shared _tools source collector extension plus standalone HTML artifact.
Add the monitor into agent-platform as a platform artifact.
folder_structure_decision_notes: Selected workspace-monitor root project because it has independent deployment, UI lifecycle, generated data, and tests.
Rejected adding it to agent-platform because the monitoring site has a separate product/deployment boundary.
folder_semantics_notes: app contains Next.js routes and global CSS.
scripts contains repository parsing and snapshot generation.
src/generated contains committed monitor data used by static builds.
docs/specs/tests contain project-local documentation, spec, and validation.
maintainability_notes: Snapshot generation separates data collection from UI rendering.
TypeScript types make future document categories and UI fields easier to extend.
Project-local docs and specs keep deployment decisions discoverable.
findings: Next.js static export is a fit for a document snapshot dashboard.
Vercel has first-class Next.js deployment support.
Public deployment needs a committed, reviewable snapshot rather than opaque runtime scanning.
recommendation: Build a separate workspace-monitor Next.js project with a repository snapshot generator and static dashboard UI.

post_research_answers.what_was_verified: Verified Next.js static export docs, Vercel Next.js deployment docs, MDX guidance, icon package source, and repository project-boundary rules.
post_research_answers.best_option: A separate Next.js static snapshot dashboard project.
post_research_answers.why_this_option: It matches the user's Next.js/Vercel request, keeps project boundaries clean, and makes public data review explicit.
post_research_answers.alternatives_rejected: Server-side runtime reader was rejected due to public/private data and Vercel runtime ambiguity; single HTML artifact was rejected because it limits future management UI growth.
post_research_answers.implementation_impact: Create workspace-monitor package, collector script, generated snapshot, UI components, docs, tests, installation record, and project registry entry.
post_research_answers.risks_and_unknowns: Vercel parent path behavior may differ; public snapshot may contain private data unless reviewed.
post_research_answers.validation_plan: Run npm run collect, npm test, npm run check, npm run build, local browser verification, grounding, and work evaluation.
post_research_answers.reusable_knowledge: Capture deployment and public snapshot review rules in workspace-monitor docs.
post_research_answers.next_action: Implement the project and install project-local dependencies.

risks_or_unknowns: Public snapshot content must be reviewed before deploy.
Vercel build root behavior may require adjusting MONITOR_REPO_ROOT.
